title: Editor E4 remainder: the RSC-canvas parity harness
detail:
Split from PROG-E4C on 2026-11-10. The canvas shows client-rendered content in the preview frame; the E4 definition also wants proof that what the frame draws matches what the server renders for the same document (RSC parity), so the editor never shows a page the visitor does not get. Dark.

Closed 2026-11-10: components/builder/canvas/rsc-parity.test.tsx renders three node documents (one block, two columns, a hidden block) through the server renderer and through a client root, and requires identical markup. Scope: the node grid's own output, with stub block nodes; real block renderers are covered by their own tests.

verify.note: Fails on main: no parity test exists. Passes once components/builder/canvas/rsc-parity.test.tsx exists and the suite is green.
